scope: The Museo Histórico Provincial Marqués de Sobre Monte in Córdoba as seen in January 2009. The scope includes both street fronts, the lime-plastered portal and wraparound timber balcony, tile roofs and five open patios.

originalReview.notes: The 2009 photograph shows a white lime-plastered façade with stepped stone portal and columns, dark timber doors, upper wrought-metal balconets and a clay tile eave.

quallaSearch.notes: Used the exact first-party public-domain Qualla original. The native account redirect verifies the uploader and credited photographer are the same account.
